system.notes:
Colossal triple-tailed red scorpion. Stingers drip lava. Awakens when the Inferno Star is visible in the night sky.

AC 17, HP 109, ATK 3 stinger (near) +10 (3d6) or triple flame beam, MV double near (burrow), S +6, D +2, C +6, I -3, W +4, Ch +4, AL C, LV 23

Burrowing Charge. In place of attacks, move up to far in a straight line and make 1 stinger attack. If hit, x4 damage. Can burrow during charge.

Immortal. Only damaged by magic sources. Immune to acid, cold, fire, and lightning. If slain, resurrects in 1d10 days and flees.

Triple Flame Beam. Three straight lines (5' wide) extending far from Bezravnis. DEX 15+ or 4d6 damage.
